subject: verifyDiscordLinkCode is a SECOND, unused implementation of the Discord account-linking rule - deployed, zero callers, and nothing holds it in agreement with the /link handler that students actually reach
description:
Found 2026-09-19 while verifying that Discord linking works.

MEASURED: verifyDiscordLinkCode is DEPLOYED (confirmed via firebase functions:list). It has ZERO callers: no reference in _app/dashboard.html, and grep across _app finds none anywhere. The live path is the /link command inside discordInteraction, which looks the code up in Firestore and does the work INLINE rather than calling the callable. So the platform carries two copies of the same rule: validate a 6-char code, refuse it if used or expired, mark it used, write discord_links/{discordId} -> uid, mirror discordId onto users/{uid}.

WHY THIS IS A REAL RISK IN THIS CODEBASE SPECIFICALLY: duplicated rules have bitten it before. functions/index.js:358 records 'Three conflicting notions of pwned previously existed in this codebase', and the CTF tie-break is duplicated between _app/components/CtfStandings.js and functions/ctf-standings-rule.js with _tools/tournament/standings-parity.test.js wired into deploy gate 3.8 SPECIFICALLY to hold them in agreement, because 'the previous arrangement, a comment promising they matched, was already false'. This duplication has no such guard.

RIGHT NOW THEY AGREE, measured rather than assumed: _tools/rules-test/discord-link.test.js exercises BOTH paths and asserts the callable writes the same mapping shape (discordUsername, email, linkedAt, uid) and refuses a replay the same way. 16/0.

TWO OPTIONS, operator decides:
1. Remove the dead callable. Needs authorization: there is no deletion authority in the session that found this, and it is a deployed function, so removing it is a production change, not a file edit.
2. Keep it and treat discord-link.test.js as its parity guard, the standings-parity pattern. If so it should be wired into a gate rather than left as a manual TOOL, or it guards nothing the day someone edits one path.

Option 2 with the gate wiring is the cheaper of the two and matches existing precedent.
